title: Order Dockerfile steps so dependencies stay cached
diff:
FROM node:22-slim AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:22-slim
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
USER node
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]

concepts.description: Each Dockerfile step is a cached layer; a changed step invalidates every step after it, so slow, rarely changing steps go first.
concepts.context: COPY package.json before COPY . . in the Dockerfile keeps npm ci cached until dependencies change

concepts.description: A multi-stage build compiles in one image and copies only the output into a smaller final image.
concepts.context: the second FROM in the Dockerfile copies only dist and node_modules from the build stage

concepts.description: Running as an unprivileged user limits what a compromised process can do inside and outside the container.
concepts.context: USER node in the Dockerfile drops root before CMD starts the server
